text:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU pool 'us-west-2-gpu-pool-a' queue depth > 95% for 3m, autoscaler unable to provision additional nodes. Paging oncall.
eli: acked. I'm oncall.
marta: seeing high 429s and request queue growth on the hosted API routes that hit heavy models. Dashboards spike around 18:12 UTC.
sre-jordan: logs show repeated CUDA/Xid errors on several nodes starting ~18:09. That will reduce available GPUs.
eli: can you paste a sampler of the Xid errors?
sre-jordan: sure:
```
[2026-02-11T18:09:23Z] driver: cuda: Xid (16) GPU 2: fault in channel 00007f...
[2026-02-11T18:09:24Z] runtime: worker pid=2245 OOM killing cache entries
[2026-02-11T18:09:30Z] node-agent: node usw2-node-17 flapping, kubelet restarted
```
kayla: looks like several nodes hit OOM and then kernel reported Xid 16. Autoscaler sees nodes not ready and hits scale limit due to quotas (we're at project GPU quota). ops-lead: Confirmed quota is at limit for the account in the region.
eli: immediate priority: stabilize serving. Can we cordon the flapping nodes and drain GPUs to avoid noisy neighbors?
eng-runtime: recommend cordon+drain of nodes with Xid. Also hotfix to restart MCD driver on affected nodes. Pushing a rolling restart command now.
eli: run the drain on these hosts: `usw2-node-15, usw2-node-17, usw2-node-22` — do it one at a time.
marta: started draining usw2-node-15 -> some pods evicted, but queue still growing.
sre-jordan: autoscaler logs show repeatedly failing provisioning attempts: cloud provider returns AllocationError due to GPU SKU shortage. That + quota means we can't spin new nodes.
ops-lead: requesting emergency quota bump from cloud accounts; raised ticket 54622, support acknowledged but ETA ~ 45m.
eli: mitigation plan B: reduce footprint by directing heavy model routes to a smaller quantized variant and enable aggressive batching/caching for the next 30m. Marta can you flip routing rules?
marta: switching route mappings now: `heavy-llm -> heavy-llm-quantized-v2` and enabling prefix KV cache for common prompts. Doing a canary now.
eli: canary looks good — latency improves and queue drops ~15%.
eng-runtime: also pushing a runtime config to lower max_concurrent_streams to 6 for heavy models to reduce mem pressure. Command:
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/runtime/config \
 -d '{"route":"heavy-llm","max_concurrent_streams":6}'
```
kayla: applied config, memory pressure dropping on remaining nodes.
incident-bot: NOTE: Customer-facing errors >10% for orgs A/B/C, triggered incident status: degraded.
eli: communication: ops-lead please draft short customer note (statuspage) informing of degraded performance and mitigations.
ops-lead: posted to status with note: "Degraded inference performance for some hosted models in us-west-2. We are rerouting to quantized variants and applying mitigations. No customer data impacted."
pagerduty: oncall escalation to secondary in 20m if not stable.
sre-jordan: after drains and runtime configs, we still see intermittent Xid errors on node-22. Suggest we reprovision that host from scratch (recreate VM) to ensure driver/kernel clean state.
eli: agree. ops-lead, please reprovision node-22 and don't rejoin until we validate kernel logs.
ops-lead: reprovision started.
eng-runtime: note for postmortem: possible root causes = driver memory leak under certain sequence lengths + scheduling packing that increased sustained utilization, triggering OOM followed by Xid kernel-level faults.
eli: any risk to Dedicated customers on same hardware? kayla?
kayla: Dedicated pools are isolated by project tag; we verified no cross-pool eviction. Good.
ops-lead: cloud quota still pending; we won't scale beyond current until quota confirmed.
marta: queue length stabilizing at ~40% of previous peak after routing changes and drains. 429s down from 18% -> 4%.
eli: good. Prepare handoff notes for the next oncall. Include which nodes were reprovisioned, what runtime flags changed, and link to tickets.
eng-runtime: adding temporary metrics alert: `gpu.xid_rate > 1/min` for 10m to catch recurrence.
eli: summary for handoff: timeline + actions:
- 18:09 alert: high queue, Xid errors and OOMs
- 18:12 cordoned/drained nodes 15/17 -> reduced noise
- 18:20 route roll to quantized variant + KV cache -> queue drop
- 18:28 runtime config reduced concurrent streams
- 18:35 reprovisioned node-22
- 18:41 statuspage posted
- 18:45 autoscaler still blocked by quota, cloud support ticket 54622
Next oncall: monitor Xid alert, confirm cloud quota bump or apply longer-term fallback (route more traffic to other regions), and schedule RCA with infra + runtime teams.
ops-lead: handoff note posted: https://internal/ops/incidents/1823456789
eli: handing to marta for overnight watch. I'm available if it flares.
marta: taking primary. ping me if Xid > 0.5/min or 429s > 5%.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status -> monitoring. If stable for 2h will move to resolved.
eli: closing thread here, will add postmortem draft tomorrow. :thumbsup:
